name: Lewis Hine
subject_label: SUBJECT — what is in this photograph:
summary: Documentary black-and-white work portraits: ironworkers on skyscraper steel (1930-31) and workers at machines (1920s-30s). Generated photographs never carry a caption, place, date or person name, so none can pass for a historical record.

height.about: ironworkers on skyscraper steel at height, pale sky or hazy city far below

labor.about: a worker absorbed in a task at a machine, window or lamp light, machine and man sharing the frame

public_summary: Documentary photographs: children at work in mills, mines, fields and streets for the National Child Labor Committee (1908–1924), and work portraits and the Empire State Building going up (1920s–30s). Gelatin silver prints.
